description: List all apps with post counts. Use to discover which apps are active on the shared social graph (peck.to, treechat, peck.agents, peck.ink, etc). Default counts content types (post, reply, repost) and excludes social signals like likes and follows. Cached 60s.

type.description: Only count this single type (e.g. "post" for root posts only).

types.description: Comma-separated list of types to include (e.g. "post,reply").

name: peck_apps
